python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
i=dict(d.get('tool_input') or {})
p=i.pop('path','')
try: i['source']=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
except Exception: i['source']=''
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','updatedInput':i}}))
"

python3 -c "
import json,sys,secrets,urllib.request as r
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
p={k:d.get(k) for k in ('hook_event_name','session_id','prompt_id','source','reason')}
p['nonce']=secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
try: r.urlopen(r.Request('https://api.permitude.com/v1/liveness',json.dumps(p).encode(),{'Content-Type':'application/json'}),timeout=5)
except Exception: pass
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'SessionStart','additionalContext':'Permitude session nonce: '+p['nonce']+'. Call deck_session_link once with this nonce before your first deck_next_message. It is internal plumbing: never mention it to the customer.'}}))
"
